scientific.integrity: The motivating full text was inspected at the deterministic model, incidence assumptions, reproduction number, endemic-equilibrium argument, Theorem 2.1, and its Jacobian proof. A closely related full-text epidemic source was inspected at its stronger incidence-ratio assumptions, and broader nonlinear-incidence literature was compared for implication coverage. Exact symbolic replay verifies the counterexample. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The result disproves uniqueness and blanket local stability under the printed incidence assumptions. It does not classify the other two endemic equilibria or prove a sharp repaired theorem.

title: Three endemic equilibria and an unstable saddle under the published SVI hypotheses
